questions_and_answers.question_text: Zhèiběn Fǎwén zhōukān xiāngdāng bú cuò!

answers.answer_text: This French weekly is quite good!

questions_and_answers.question_text: A! Nǐ xiànzài duì Fǎwén hěn yǒu yánjiū le, néng kàn Fǎwén zázhì le!

answers.answer_text: Oh! You know a lot about French now; you can read French magazines!

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nánnǚ píngděng shi bu shi Zhōngguo rénde kànfǎ?

answers.answer_text: Is equality between men and women a Chinese viewpoint?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Shì, kěshi nèi shi Zhōngguo rénde xīn guānniàn, bú shi lǎo guānniàn.

answers.answer_text: Yes, but that's a new concept of the Chinese, not an old one.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Zhèipiān wénzhāng bù hǎo ma?

answers.answer_text: Isn't this article any good?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Bú shi zhèige yìsi. Wénzhāng bú cuò, jiù shi chángle yìdiǎnr.

answers.answer_text: That wasn't what I meant. The article is pretty good, it's just that it's a bit long.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nǐ hái yǒu shénme biéde wénzhāng ma?

answers.answer_text: Do you have any other articles?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nǐ jiéhūn yǐqián yìzhí dōu gēn fùmǔ yìqǐ zhù ma?

answers.answer_text: Before you got married did you live with your parents all along?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Bú shi, wǒ méi jiéhūn jiù líkāi jiā dúlì shēnghuóle qī-bā nián.

answers.answer_text: No, I left home before I got married and lived independently for seven or eight years.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nǐ kàn, zhèr yǒu yìpiān guānyú tóngjūde xīnwén.

answers.answer_text: Look, here's a news article about "living together."

questions_and_answers.question_text: Suàn le ba. Zhèizhǒng xīnwén yǒu shénme yìsi?

answers.answer_text: Forget it. What's interesting about that kind of news?

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nǐ jiějie yīxué fāngmiànde shū yuè lái yuè duō le!

answers.answer_text: Your sister is getting more and more medical books!

questions_and_answers.question_text: Shì a, tā zài pīnmìng xué yī ne.

answers.answer_text: Yes, she's studying medicine with all her energy.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Liú Xiānshengde kè shízài méi yìsi.

answers.answer_text: Mr. Liú's class is really boring.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nǐ tīngxiaqu, mànmanr huì yǒu xìngqùde.

answers.answer_text: If you keep attending it, gradually you'll become interested.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Xiàng Wáng Jiàoshòu zhèiyàngde lǎoshī zhēnshi bù duō.

answers.answer_text: There really aren't many teachers like Professor Wáng.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nǐ shuōduì le. Rúguǒ bú shi tā bāngzhu wǒ, wǒ zhēn bù xiǎng xué le.

answers.answer_text: You're right. If it weren't for the help he's given me, I wouldn't want to study anymore.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Sānnián yǐqián wǒ jiù bú kào fùmǔ shēnghuó le.

answers.answer_text: I stopped depending on my parents for a living three years ago.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nǐ néng zìjǐ guǎn zìjǐ, zhēn bú cuò.

answers.answer_text: It's really great that you can take care of yourself (be your own boss).

questions_and_answers.question_text: Tā xiěde jǐběn xiǎoshuō xiànzài dōu hěn liúxíng.

answers.answer_text: The novels he wrote are all very popular now.

questions_and_answers.question_text: Nà dāngrán, xiàng tā nèiyàng yǒu dìwèi yǒu zhīshide rén, xiěde xiǎoshuō yídìng yǒu yìsi.

answers.answer_text: Of course. Novels written by someone with his position and knowledge are sure to be interesting.

questions_and_answers.question_text: yǒu bāngzhu

answers.answer_text: to be helpful

questions_and_answers.question_text: yǒu dàolǐ

answers.answer_text: to make sense

questions_and_answers.question_text: zìyóu

answers.answer_text: to be free; freedom

questions_and_answers.question_text: -bèizi

answers.answer_text: all one's life, lifetime

questions_and_answers.question_text: Xīnwén Zhōukān

answers.answer_text: Newsweek

questions_and_answers.question_text: fùnǚ

answers.answer_text: woman; women, womankind
